rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual abbreviation for a microphone.

example.english: The concert is about to start, so quickly pass me the microphone.
example.traditional: 演唱會就開始喇，快啲將個咪遞畀我。
example.jyutping: jin2 coeng3 wui2 zau6 hoi1 ci2 laa3 faai3 di1 zoeng1 go3 mai1 dai6 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this full everyday term when you want to name the device clearly.

example.english: Please hand the microphone to the speaker on stage.
example.traditional: 請將咪高峰交畀台上嘅講者。
example.jyutping: cing2 zoeng1 mai1 gou1 fung1 gaau1 bei2 toi1 soeng6 ge3 gong2 ze2

rows.note: Use this colloquial synonym when referring to the physical microphone itself.

example.english: My microphone got damaged, so it can't pick up sound.
example.traditional: 我個咪頭跌爛咗，收唔到聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 mai5 tau4 dit3 laan6 zo2 sau1 m4 dou3 seng1
